title: Replace the tier switch with a strategy registry
prompt: `priceFor` in `src/pricing.js` is one long `switch` on the customer tier. Refactor it into a strategy registry without changing any result: create `src/strategies.js` exporting `registerStrategy(tier, fn)`, `getStrategy(tier)` and `listTiers()`. A strategy is `fn(subtotalCents)` returning `{ discount, shipping }` (both in cents). `getStrategy` throws `Error("unknown tier: <tier>")` for a tier that is not registered, `registerStrategy` throws `Error("tier already registered: <tier>")` for a tier that already is, and `listTiers()` lists the tiers in registration order. The four existing tiers (standard, silver, gold, staff) are registered when the module loads. After the refactor `priceFor` contains no tier names and works for tiers registered later by callers. Export the new functions from `src/index.js`. Run the tests with `npm test`.
